title: R2 elevated errors and timeouts for requests from South America

timeline.body: We are investigating elevated errors and read timeouts affecting R2 requests originating from South America (impacting datacenters such as GRU, GIG, EZE, and SCL). Our team is actively working to identify and resolve the issue.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
